blocks.text: Cebuano guard Reinhard Jumamoy showed why he is emerging as one of the frontrunners for the Most Valuable Player (MVP) award after delivering a clutch performance to power National University (NU) past De La Salle University, 84-80, in the UAAP Season 89 Collegiate Men's Basketball Tournament on Sunday at the SMART Araneta Coliseum. ...
